referenceScan.dispositionCheck: Every one of the 18 files under /srv/hot-data/energy-markets/reference is dispositioned exactly once: 9 are cited in sources[] (S-05..S-13) with a hash and locators; the other 9 are listed in notInspected[] with their sha256 and a stated reason. verify.mjs re-enumerates the directory and fails if any file is missing from both lists or appears in both.
referenceScan.finding: The 9 reference files actually inspected for this data audit (S-05..S-13) are historical research/provenance (methodology and external-system description). None contains a data series, product code, executable unit, fee, calendar or entitlement proof. The corpus itself states the 2020-2026 range is a communicated input subject to audit, not certified coverage (S-07 p.8; S-10 p.6; S-11 p.2). The remaining 9 files were not cited as evidence in this ST and carry no data source; their disposition is recorded in notInspected[].
